name: frontend
description: Next.js RSC frontend agent. Owns all files under frontend/tentree-scportal/src/. Implements UI components using shadcn/ui and Tailwind. Never touches backend/. Read SKU_EXPANSION_PLAN.md before writing any component.

name: backend
description: Express backend agent. Owns backend/server.js, backend/services/, backend/data/. Adds routes, business logic, and data mutations. Never touches frontend/. Read SKU_EXPANSION_PLAN.md before writing any route.

name: qa
description: QA/review agent. Read-only — never modifies files. Checks that frontend TypeScript types match backend JSON response shapes. Verifies routes in server.js match what frontend actions call. Reports mismatches as a numbered list.
